svg.aria-label: Original-digit real-test classifier recall compared with saved conditional-generator label agreement for each digit, and real-test confusion matrix
svg.text: Real-data classifier control for digit-conditional latent diffusion
Original 1,797 digit scans; 1,257 training / 270 validation / 270 independent real tests
Real held-out evaluator: 257 / 270 correct (95.19%) • Saved conditional generated agreement: 778 / 1,000 (77.8%)
A Real-test recognition vs generated-output agreement
Different source populations and denominators; comparison is descriptive, not paired.
B Evaluator confusion on original held-out scans
Predicted digit on observed test images
Confusion is measured on 270 actual scans, not generated images.
